title: Austin Goes Behind Closed Doors
summary:
*   **Special Purpose Meeting:** The Austin City Council held a special session solely to announce and immediately enter a closed-door executive meeting.
*   **Legal Justification:** This private deliberation was conducted under specific sections of the Texas Revised Civil Statutes, authorizing such closed sessions.
*   **Public Decisions:** While discussions were private, any final actions, decisions, or votes resulting from the executive session were required to be made in open session afterward.

CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
Special Meeting

Mayor Friedman announced that this was a Special Called Meeting of the City Council for
the purpose of publicly announcing that during the meeting it will convene in a Closed or
Executive Session authorized by Section 2, Paragraphs (e), (f), and (g) of Article
6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated; and after such closed or executive
session, any final action, decieion,~or vote with regard to any matter considered in the
closed or executive session would be made in open session, should such action, decision,
or vote be necessary.
Mayor Friedman announced that the Council would go into Executive Session at this time to
consider the items authorized by Section 2, Paragraphs
(e), (f), and (g) of Article 6252-17.
